about_the_game:
Something Is Coming...

The elves have been hunted, taken, or killed

Falner, the elf king and his two children are the only free elves that remain, hidden in a campsite, but not for long.

The Stranger and his disciples will not stop until they are found.

A story based RPG, Tales Of The Lost: The Stranger is the first in a series of stories set in a fantasy world that includes Pirates, Ghosts, Orcs and other monsters not yet found......

Wishlist today and be the first to play when released.

Key Information 

  • Story based adventure: Play as three characters, experience their story and find out what hunts them.

  • Turn-based battles: Use the power of the elves to fight monsters, orcs and humans.

  • Card Collection: Find collectable cards of characters.

  • Steam Achievements: Earn achievements by completing objectives in the story.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Graphics: Graphic board that works with OpenGL 4.4 or higher
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX1650 AMD Radeon™ RX570
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: After being hunted by a mysterious figure, the last of the elves must fight for their lives in this story based RPG.
